channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Protesters Attack US Consulate In Pakistan Over Khamenei's Killing
item.description: At least nine people were killed when a crowd of students attempted to storm the US consulate in Karachi, Pakistan, on March 1. The deaths followed joing US-Isreali strikes on Iran that killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Iranian Drones Attack Naval Base In Abu Dhabi
item.description: An Iranian drone attack on Al Salam Naval Base in Abu Dhabi caused a fire but no casualties, UAE's Defense Ministry said on March 1 as Iran continued to launch attacks across the region for a second day after an initial wave of US-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Iran's Supreme Leader Is Dead. Who Will Succeed Him? It's Complicated.
item.description: The man who will succeed Ali Khamenei as Iran’s spiritual leader will take the helm at a time when US officials have openly called for toppling the theocratic government that has ruled the country since 1979.

item.title: Hanna Notte: US-Israeli Attack On Iran 'Will Only Harden Russia's Position On Ukraine'
item.description: The US-Israeli attack on Iran will likely have little effect on the battlefield in Ukraine, but it may make Russian President Vladimir Putin “even more adamant that he has to come out on top” in the full-scale war he launched four years ago, Hanna Notte, an expert on Russia-Iran ties, told RFE/RL.

item.title: Attacks On Shipping Raise Fears For Global Oil Supplies Amid Iran Conflict
item.description: Cellphone footage showing tongues of flame and thick, black smoke billowing from a ship in the Strait of Hormuz is an ominous image underlining fears of disruption to global oil supplies amid the US and Israeli conflict with Iran.

item.title: Satellite Images Show Iranian Missile Base Before And After Strikes
item.description: Satellite images taken by Planet Labs PBC reveal the damage inflicted on an Iranian missile base in northwestern Tabriz. The base was hit on February 28 as the United States and Israel launched attacks against Iran, killing the country's supreme leader and top military figures.

item.title: Israel And Iran Exchange New Strikes After Khamenei Death
item.description: Footage shows smoke rising across Tehran as Israel reportedly targeted central locations of the capital with strikes. Iran retaliated with missile strikes against US and Israeli targets. US President Donald Trump said the new Iranian leadership wants to resume negotiations.

item.title: In Latest Statement, Trump Urges Iranians To “Take Back Your Country”
item.description: In a video statement on his Truth Social platform, US President Donald Trump spoke to the Iranian people, saying they should “seize the moment” and that “America is with you.” He also vowed to avenge the deaths of three US service members, and said more casualties are likely before the war ends.

item.title: Larijani Says 'Will Not Negotiate' With US As Trump Vows To Punish Iran With 'Full Force'
item.description: Powerful Iranian security chief Ali Larijani said Tehran "will not negotiate" with Washington, hours after US President Donald Trump vowed to continue to punish the "terrorists" with the "full force" of the American military.

item.title: Satellite Images Show Damage To Military Sites Across Iran
item.description: Before and after photos released on March 1 show extensive damage to missile bases, radar installations, and aircraft facilities in Iran after a barrage of US and Israeli air strikes. One set of images shows the Tehran compound of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was killed in a strike on February 28.
